input.title: Business Performance Partner – Lines of Solution-Orange Wholesale Intl
input.summary: Advise Orange’s wholesale business on profitability, growth and portfolio performance from Casablanca. The role combines commercial finance, market analysis and strategic planning, helping product, sales and finance leaders challenge assumptions and turn performance insights into better business decisions.
input.aboutRole: The Business Performance Partner works across Lines of Solution and product teams, providing an independent view of revenue, margins, customer portfolios and market position. Its remit spans business reviews, forecasts and strategic plans, with close collaboration with analytics specialists to improve decision tools and performance governance across international activities.
responsibilities: Prepare product and business reviews with integrated revenue, margin and portfolio analysis.
Explain deviations from forecasts and strategic targets and recommend corrective actions.
Challenge pricing, volume, cost and growth assumptions with market and customer evidence.
Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and planning with Product, Sales and Finance.
Develop executive insights and improve KPI reliability, dashboards and decision follow-up.
requirements: Master’s degree in finance, economics, strategy or a related field is identified in the candidate profile.
Experience in P&L analysis, business reviews, forecasting, budgeting and strategic cycles.
Fluent French and English, with strong advisory and stakeholder-influencing skills.
Advanced Excel and familiarity with visualisation tools such as Power BI, Dataiku or ThinkCell.
Knowledge of B2B telecommunications, wholesale, infrastructure or digital services.

editorial.reason: Revenue and margin analysis, forecast variance and corrective advice substantiate business partnering.

input.title: General Manager, Core M&A — GSM Platforms
input.summary: Lead acquisition strategy and execution for MTN’s core GSM platform businesses. This senior M&A position combines target origination, financial assessment, deal structuring and negotiation, supporting portfolio growth, strategic partnerships and investment decisions across the Group’s operating markets.
input.aboutRole: The General Manager works with Group functions and platform businesses to execute the M&A lifecycle within governance and risk requirements. The mandate includes acquisition targets, joint ventures and new licence bids, with responsibility for valuation, investment structures and post-deal handover. The position also leads a team and oversees initiative budgets and reporting.
responsibilities: Shape GSM-platform M&A priorities and originate potential acquisition targets.
Lead diligence and assess strategic fit, financial viability, synergies and risk.
Coordinate capital-structure advice, valuation, financial modelling and transaction negotiations.
Lead licence-bid teams on valuation, shareholder consortia and investment structures.
Manage partnerships, investment budgets and executive reporting, ensuring clear integration handover.
requirements: Four-year tertiary degree in finance, business or a related discipline.
MBA or equivalent master’s qualification is listed as a requirement for this role.
At least five years as a seasoned senior manager specialising in corporate finance, investment banking or M&A transactions.
Proven M&A origination and execution, corporate-finance and strategic-planning experience.
Fluent English and cross-cultural experience; multinational emerging-market experience and relevant professional accreditation are advantageous.

editorial.reason: Owns the corporate group’s acquisition pipeline, valuation, structuring and negotiation.

input.title: Chargé d’étude
input.summary: Produce feasibility studies, business cases and project-portfolio analysis for Africa Global Logistics in Côte d’Ivoire. Working under the PMO, the role helps management evaluate opportunities, understand project performance and make decisions using reliable data, budgets, risk information and governance reporting.
input.aboutRole: The analyst supports both strategic and operational projects and consolidates information from project managers into management dashboards. The work combines market and opportunity studies with portfolio monitoring, documentation and improved project methods. Familiarity with transport, logistics and the African business context is valued, while the advert does not specify a city.
responsibilities: Conduct market, opportunity and feasibility studies and prepare business cases.
Collect, validate and analyse data supporting project decisions.
Consolidate portfolio schedules, budgets, risks, milestones and performance indicators.
Prepare dashboards, executive reports and governance presentations.
Improve PMO methods, documentation quality and project-management standards.
requirements: Bac+4/5 in project management, strategy, finance, economics, data or business analysis, engineering or equivalent.
Two to four years in studies, PMO, consulting, project oversight or strategy consulting.
Advanced Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI skills, with experience producing business cases and management dashboards.
Good English for international exchanges and English-language tools.
Knowledge of African or Ivorian markets and transport or logistics is advantageous.
